advisor_identified: Historian of Zimbabwe in the Department of History and Classics, University of Alberta.

doctorate.title: Cultivating Conflict: 'Improved' Agriculture and Modernization in Colonial Zimbabwe, 1920-1965

evidence.says: The University of Minnesota doctoral register lists Guy Desmond Thompson, History PhD, awarded November 2000, with the dissertation Cultivating Conflict: 'Improved' Agriculture and Modernization in Colonial Zimbabwe, 1920-1965.

Thompson's 2010 article identifies his affiliation as Alberta's Department of History and Classics. In footnote 8 he explicitly cites his own doctoral dissertation at the University of Minnesota (PhD, 2000), under the title Cultivating Conflict: Modernism and 'Improved' Agriculture in Colonial Zimbabwe, 1920–1965.

notes: The Minnesota register matches the linked record's institution, year and title (with the date range expanded). Thompson's self-citation independently connects that doctorate to the Alberta historian; its subtitle varies slightly. The doctorate title above follows the awarding university's register.
